engineering_definition: Crest freeboard relative to the incident wave height: degree of overtopping protection.
physical_interpretation: Low classes: frequent green-water overtopping; high classes: rare overtopping events.
limitations: Bin edges are round engineering values, not physical regime boundaries; within-bin variation is carried by the slot direction.

engineering_definition: Fictitious wave steepness s_m-1,0 = 2 pi Hm0,toe / (g Tm-1,0,toe^2).
label_rule: bins at 0.01 (swell-like or broken waves) and 0.04 (wind sea), EurOtop convention
physical_interpretation: Low steepness: long/surging or depth-broken waves; high: steep wind sea.
limitations: Steepness at the toe mixes offshore sea state and foreshore transformation.

engineering_definition: Toe water depth relative to wave height (foreshore depth regime).
label_rule: bins at 1 and 4 (very shallow / shallow / deep, after Hofland et al. 2017)
physical_interpretation: Shallow classes imply depth-limited, broken waves at the toe.
expected_interactions: steepness (C2), foreshore (C10), profile (C5: impulsive conditions at walls)
limitations: The <1 class is small; emergent toes (h<=0) fall in it.

engineering_definition: Angle of wave attack relative to the structure normal.
limitations: Short-crestedness is not recorded in the database.

engineering_definition: Type of seaward profile from the lower and upper slope cotangents.
label_rule: steep = cot<1; uniform if both >=1 and equal within 2 %; composite if both >=1 and different; mixed and wall classes by which part is steep
n_per_state: uniform slope: 6138; composite slope: 598; slope with wall on top: 603; wall with slope above: 265; vertical/steep wall: 1729
physical_interpretation: Separates sloping, vertical and mixed structures, whose overtopping physics differ.
limitations: cot<1 as 'steep' follows the usual 1:1 convention; recurves/overhangs (negative cot) are merged with walls.

engineering_definition: Presence and position of a berm.
label_rule: B=0; B>0 and hb>0; B>0 and hb<=0
n_per_state: no berm: 7824; submerged berm: 806; berm at/above SWL: 703
physical_interpretation: Berms dissipate energy; effect depends on berm level relative to SWL.
limitations: Berm width is carried by the slot direction, not by the label.

engineering_definition: Surface roughness / permeability expressed by gamma_f.
n_per_state: smooth (gf=1): 3787; moderately rough (0.6<gf<1): 1177; rough armour (gf<=0.6): 4360; undefined: 9
physical_interpretation: Lower gamma_f = more dissipation on the slope.
limitations: gamma_f in CLASH is itself an assigned (partly estimated) value, not a measurement.

engineering_definition: Presence of a toe berm in front of the structure.
physical_interpretation: A toe can trigger breaking or have little effect.
limitations: Toe significance (ht/Hm0) is carried by the slot direction.

engineering_definition: Configuration of the crest: armour crest berm and crown wall.
label_rule: Gc=0 and Ac=Rc; Rc<=Ac with Gc>0 or Ac>Rc; Rc>Ac
n_per_state: plain crest: 4245; armour crest, wall not protruding: 3015; protruding crown wall: 2073
physical_interpretation: Permeable crest width and wall protrusion reduce overtopping.

engineering_definition: Foreshore slope in front of the structure.
physical_interpretation: Steep foreshores change breaker type at the structure.
limitations: m=1000 is a database convention for flat/deep foreshore.
